definition_en: clever trickery used to deceive, or skillful ingenuity in making things
core_image: 幕后巧手布下的机关与圈套
scene: 谈判桌上他笑容可掬，袖中却捏着一份拟好的附加条款。The treaty failed because of his artifice.
sceneCN: 这里 artifice 是「诡计」（第 1 个义项：欺骗性的巧计）；句意是因为他的花招，条约告吹。

derivatives.zh: artifice 加 -er，义为「巧匠；技工；（军）工兵」
同根形容词，义为「人工的；虚假的」
art 加 -ful，义为「狡猾的；巧妙的」

senses.title: Clever deception
senses.definition: a cunning trick or scheme designed to deceive others
senses.definitionCN: 旨在欺骗他人的狡猾手段或圈套
senses.example: Her apology was just an artifice to win back his trust.
senses.exampleCN: 她的道歉不过是赢回他信任的伎俩。
senses.why: Ars means skill, so a skill turned toward cheating becomes artifice.
senses.whyCN: ars 意为「技艺」，技艺用于行骗便成了 artifice。

senses.title: Skillful ingenuity in making
senses.definition: ingenious skill in construction or craftsmanship, sometimes admiring
senses.definitionCN: 制作上的精巧技艺，有时含赞赏意味
senses.example: The clock shows the artifice of eighteenth-century makers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座钟显示了十八世纪工匠的巧艺。
senses.why: The original sense of trained skill remains in this neutral use.
senses.whyCN: 「受训技艺」的本义保留在这一中性用法中。

senses.title: Artificial contrivance, lack of naturalness
senses.definition: unnatural cleverness or affectation in manner or expression
senses.definitionCN: 举止或表达中不自然的做作与矫饰
senses.example: She spoke with such artifice that nobody believed her.
senses.exampleCN: 她说话矫揉造作，没人相信她。
senses.why: Made skill contrasts with what is genuine and natural.
senses.whyCN: 人造之巧与真实自然相对照。

intro.en: Artifice comes from Latin artificium, something made with skill, from ars and facere.
intro.cn: artifice 源自拉丁语 artificium（以技艺制成之物），由 ars 与 facere 复合。

items.en: Root *h2er- (to fit together) gives ars, skill; *dheh1- gives facere, to make.
items.cn: 词根 *h2er-（接合）衍生 ars（技艺）；*dheh1- 衍生 facere（制作）（重构形式）。

items.en: Artificium meant a work of skill, craft, or device.
items.cn: 拉丁语 artificium 指技艺之作、工艺或巧器。

items.en: Old French artifice carried both craftsmanship and cunning device.
items.cn: 古法语 artifice 兼指工艺与狡黠机巧。

items.en: The word entered English in the sixteenth century with the trickery sense uppermost.
items.cn: 16 世纪该词进入英语，诡计义已占上风。

items.en: Today it names deception primarily, with neutral craftsmanship senses in older texts.
items.cn: 现代英语以欺骗义为主，中性工艺义多见于早期文本。

note.en: Artifice is the dark twin of art: the same skill, aimed at cheating.
note.cn: artifice 是 art 的暗面孪生：同样的技艺，用于行骗。

entries.definitionCN: 人工的、非天然的，artifice 的同根形容词
巧匠、技工，artifice 的施动者名词
办公室（复数），词尾拼写相近但词义无关
诱敌之计、骗局，与 artifice 的诡计义相近
狡诈，侧重品性中的欺骗倾向

entries.definition: a plan or scheme for gaining an advantage
entries.definitionCN: 计谋、策略，军事色彩较浓

normalIntro.en: See art plus fice (make): skill used to make tricks.
normalIntro.cn: 把词看成 art + fice（制作）：用技艺做圈套。

normal.cn: ars（技艺）+ facere（制作）＝巧制之器。

normal.en: The dark sense dominates: cunning deception.
Without artifice means honest and natural.
A stratagem is a grander plan; an artifice a smaller trick.
normal.cn: stratagem 是大计，artifice 是小伎俩。

abstract.en: Picture a magician's sleeve hiding the trick card.
abstract.cn: 想象魔术师袖中藏着的戏法牌。

abstract.en: See a smiling face with crossed fingers behind its back.
abstract.cn: 想象一张笑脸背后交叉着手指。

abstract.en: Hear gears clicking inside a false-bottomed box.
abstract.cn: 聆听暗层盒子里的齿轮咔嗒声。

examples.en: The spy's artifice won him access to the files.
examples.cn: 间谍的巧计为他打开了档案室。

examples.en: She won the game by artifice rather than skill.
examples.cn: 她靠诡计而非实力赢了比赛。

examples.en: The film avoids all artifice and simply records daily life.
examples.cn: 这部影片毫无矫饰，只是记录日常生活。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿提·菲斯」——阿提在费用（fee）报表上耍花招，谎报数目，全靠「阿提菲斯」的伎俩。

root: 拉丁语 ars（技艺）+ facere（制作）→ artificium（巧制之物）→ 古法语 artifice → 英语 artifice；同根词 artificial、artisan、artifact。

sensesIntro.en: From skilled making to cunning deception and artificial manner.
sensesIntro.cn: 由精巧的制作延伸到狡黠的欺骗与做作的举止。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: skilled hands building a hidden trap
core.cn: 核心意象：巧手暗造机关

branches.cn: 人造表面与真实的对照

intro.en: The root facere (make) recurs across English words of making.
intro.cn: 词根 facere（制作）反复出现在英语制作用词中。

latinIntro.en: Ars (skill) also gives art, artist, artifact and artisan.
latinIntro.cn: ars（技艺）同时派生出 art、artist、artifact 与 artisan。
